column1: # smrna-nextflow — probe sequences (read probes). One row per probe: probe_id, sequence.
# sequence: DNA or RNA, any case; spaces and hyphens are ignored; U is read as T.
# A read counts if it equals a substring of the probe (or of its reverse
# complement) of at least probe_min_len nt, in either orientation. Pass the
# whole hairpin or just the guide; both are handled.
# Set probe_file in params.yaml to this file (or your own). probe_mismatches is
# 0 or 1 (default 0). Set probe_top_unknown_n > 0 to also dump the most abundant
